step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram presents a data ingestion and storage architecture between a Customer environment and Splunk. External customer data sources (Data, Lambda, Kinesis Firehose) route data across boundary lines into Splunk's ELBs. HEC data flows through the top ELB, while Firehose data flows through the bottom ELB. Both load balancers distribute data to EC2 indexer instances. The EC2 instances persist and tier data into Splunk S3 and Glacier storage, and can export data directly back into the Customer S3 bucket.
